ITEM 1 | Cherry tomatoes, halved and whole, bright red with glossy skin, cut faces showing pale seeds, piled on the left upper side of the plate, about 8 cm across the cluster | 110
ITEM 2 | Green beans, slender, bright green with some darker blistered spots, lightly cooked and still firm, laid in a loose diagonal bundle across the top center of the plate, about 12 cm long | 75
ITEM 3 | Sliced yellow-green squash or pepper rings, pale yellow-green with slightly glossy skin, curved slices about 0.5 cm thick, arranged in a small heap at the upper right edge | 45
ITEM 4 | Diced potato pieces, pale cream to golden-edged cubes about 1.5 to 2 cm, slightly crisp browned edges, dusted with small green herb flecks, mounded in the lower left quadrant | 130
ITEM 5 | Sliced mushrooms, pale tan to brown caps, moist and soft, scattered among the potatoes and near the center, about 1 cm slices | 25
ITEM 6 | Cooked white onion pieces, translucent pale ivory layers, soft and slightly glossy, scattered with the potatoes in the lower center | 20
ITEM 7 | Fish fillet, flaky light pink-orange flesh with a golden browned crust and dark herb or seasoning flecks on the surface, about 9 by 6 cm and 2 cm thick, sitting on the right side of the plate | 150
ITEM 8 | Second fish piece, pale pinkish-cream flesh with a lightly browned edge and slight flaking, about 6 by 4 cm, partly under the first fillet at the far right edge | 70
ITEM 9 | Cooking oil or sauce residue, thin glossy film pooled lightly on the plate beside the fish and potatoes, nearly transparent with a slight sheen | 10
